title: Warna Sepia di Perjalanan Pulang
theme: Menemukan keindahan dalam pertemuan singkat dan tak terduga, yang membangkitkan nostalgia dan harapan tersembunyi di tengah perjalanan malam.

cover.prompt: Interior perspective from a train carriage at a quiet moment, looking out a large window. The distant city lights form an abstract, glowing tapestry of soft hues on the glass surface, suggesting movement and a vibrant urban expanse. A laptop bag is gently placed on a seat, reflecting the serene ambient light. The composition emphasizes depth and a contemplative atmosphere, focusing on the interplay between the tranquil interior and the illuminated view outside.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: A young freelance graphic designer experiences a melancholic journey home on the last train. Her attention is drawn to another passenger, fostering an unspoken connection. Their eyes meet briefly at the final station, sharing a meaningful moment before they part ways, leaving the protagonist with a warm, reflective feeling from the unexpected encounter.
meta.target_emotion: Contemplation, gentle melancholy, subtle hope, warmth from an unexpected, fleeting connection.
